hook_en: Start this week safe in Him. 🙏
reflect_en: Before the week asks anything of you, David shows you where to begin: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge. You can bring Him every need this week, knowing He inclines His ear to you and will not let you be put to shame.
q_en: What do you need God to rescue you from this week?
x_en: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
tiktok: Start your week in His refuge 🙏 Psalm 71:1–2 — He inclines His ear to you
yt_title: In You, O LORD, I Have Taken Refuge | Psalm 71:1–2 #Shorts
li_open: Where a leader goes first on Monday matters.
li_quote: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge… incline Your ear and save me.
li_body: David began by taking refuge in God and asking Him to listen, before he faced anything else. Leaders who start the week in prayer, and give their people a place to bring their needs to God too, lead from security instead of pressure.
hook_es: Comienza la semana refugiado en Él. 🙏
reflect_es: Antes de que la semana te pida algo, David te muestra por dónde empezar: En ti, oh Jehová, he esperado. Puedes traerle cada necesidad esta semana, sabiendo que Él inclina Su oído hacia ti.
q_es: ¿De qué necesitas que Dios te libre esta semana?
x_es: En ti, oh Jehová, he esperado; no sea yo confuso para siempre.
key_en: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge
